title: Transformers are RNNs: Fast Autoregressive Transformers with Linear Attention
evidence_note: Primary proceedings paper Sections 3.2–3.4 inspected; feature-map kernel reassociation and normalized recurrent numerator/denominator. Worked customer-service interpretation is original.

title: Retentive Network: A Successor to Transformer for Large Language Models
evidence_note: Section 2.1 parallel, recurrent, and chunkwise retention; Section 2.2 fixed multi-scale per-head decay and distinct output gating. Book core recurrence explicitly suppresses positional and surrounding layer operations.

title: Gated Linear Attention Transformers with Hardware-Efficient Training
evidence_note: Sections 2–3 and related work distinguish data-dependent state decay, key/value gating, output gating, and hardware-efficient chunkwise forms. No reported throughput maxima are reproduced.

title: Mamba: Linear-Time Sequence Modeling with Selective State Spaces
evidence_note: Abstract supports input-dependent selective state-space parameters and the adjacent SSM lineage. Detailed architecture claims are not made.

title: Transformers are SSMs: Generalized Models and Efficient Algorithms Through Structured State Space Duality
evidence_note: Sections 3 and 5 inspected: semiseparable sequence operators, structured masked attention, and restricted state-space duality. Book does not equate all SSMs with softmax attention.

title: Linear Transformers Are Secretly Fast Weight Programmers
evidence_note: Fast-weight memory discussion and replacement/delta interpretation inspected. Early HTML version bears the title 'Linear Transformers Are Secretly Fast Weight Memory Systems'; latest abstract/proceedings title is listed here. Numerical example and gradient derivation are original exposition.

title: Parallelizing Linear Transformers with the Delta Rule over Sequence Length
evidence_note: Core delta recurrence and Section 3 WY/chunkwise composition inspected. Book explains structured composition without reproducing a kernel or benchmark claim.

title: Gated Delta Networks: Improving Mamba2 with Delta Rule
evidence_note: Sections 2–3 verify scalar decay followed by residual correction, complementary memory clearance and association editing, and chunkwise parallelization. Formula transposed to S in R^(dv×dk); the correction reads the faded state. First submitted December 2024, ICLR 2025.

title: Kimi Linear: An Expressive, Efficient Attention Architecture
evidence_note: Sections 2–4 and 7.2 inspected: KDA per-key-channel decay, exact gate/correction order, output sigmoid gate after RMSNorm and before output projection, 3:1 KDA/Full-MLA layerwise mixture, and finite-state retrieval limits. No maximum cache/throughput ratios quoted.

title: Qwen3-Next-80B-A3B-Instruct: Official Model Card
evidence_note: Model Overview verifies 48 layers and 12 repetitions of three Gated DeltaNet/MoE blocks followed by one Gated Attention/MoE block; explicit attention uses 16 Q and 2 KV heads.

title: Gated Attention for Large Language Models: Non-linearity, Sparsity, and Attention-Sink-Free
evidence_note: Sections 2–4 inspected: SDPA output gate, elementwise versus headwise and head-specific versus shared granularity, sparse output modulation, and nonlinearity. Output activation sparsity is explicitly distinguished from skipping attention computation.

title: On the Design of Qwen3.8-Next Architecture: Evaluation, Efficiency, and Training Stability
evidence_note: Section 2.1 confirms GDN/global mixture and continued-pretraining replacement of explicit layers by QSA; indexer averages nonoverlapping micro-block keys and expands selected blocks into token indices for core attention. Submitted August 31, 2026.

title: FG²-GDN: Enhancing Long-Context Gated Delta Networks with Doubly Fine-Grained Control
evidence_note: Sections 3.2–3.4 distinguish tied square-root key/value scaling in base FG²-GDN from independent key/value vectors in '+'. Setup specifies 340M/15B and 1.3B/100B SlimPajama tokens, common 3:1 MLA hybrid, one run per configuration; limitations inspected. First submitted April 21, revised August 31, 2026.

title: Gated DeltaNet-2: Decoupling Erase and Write in Linear Attention
evidence_note: Section 3 equations 8–10 verify independent key-channel erase read and value-channel write target with original key write direction. Section 4/setup and appendix specify 1.3B/100B FineWeb-Edu, recurrent-only and SWA hybrids. Submitted May 21, 2026; labeled research rather than established deployment.

title: Kalman Delta Networks: Uncertainty-aware Associative Memory
evidence_note: Sections 3–5 and Appendix A.1 explain Kalman residual/gain, predictive covariance, diagonal/isotropic retained projections, recurrent-only 750M/50B and 1.3B/100B experiments, and 1.3B hybrids with nine recurrent plus nine 2K-window layers. Internal association uncertainty is not calibrated final-answer confidence. Submitted September 7, revised September 29, 2026.
